notes.title: 🚨 Early Access Launch – Stellar Shapers! 🚨
notes.notes:
🌟 [b]Get ready for a completely revamped experience![/b] 🌟

The time has come! [b]Stellar Shapers is now available in Early Access[/b], bringing a wave of improvements and new content compared to the demo version! 🎮💥

[h2]What awaits you in Early Access?[/h2]
🔥 [b]Endless Waves[/b] – The 4-wave limit is a thing of the past! Now, you can face endless enemies and push your skills to the limit.

🎵 [b]Full Soundtrack[/b] – More music, more immersion! The old 4-track demo soundtrack has been replaced with a much richer musical experience.

⚙️ [b]Adjustable Difficulty[/b] – Customize your journey with modifiers that let you create the perfect challenge.

💀 [b]Powerful Bosses[/b] – All the bosses missing from the demo are now in the game! Are you ready to take them on?

🔧 [b]Unlocked Modules & Chips[/b] – No more restrictions! Now, you can unlock and combine all available modules and chips to personalize your strategy.

🔬 [b]Research & Upgrades[/b] – All improvement options are now accessible, allowing you to evolve your tactics and maximize your potential.

📈 [b]Smooth Learning Curve[/b] – Progression is now more gradual, letting you discover and enjoy every new feature at your own pace.

[h2]And there’s more! This is just the beginning![/h2]
Early Access is only the start, and plenty of new content is on the way! During this phase, we’ll continue expanding the game with exciting additions, including:

🔹 [b]Steam Achievements[/b] for you to challenge yourself and showcase your progress.
🔹 [b]New modules and chips[/b] to further expand strategic possibilities.
🔹 [b]More difficulty modifiers[/b] for even more customization options.
🔹 [b]New bosses[/b] bringing fresh and thrilling challenges!

Best of all: [b]we’re listening to you[/b]! Throughout Early Access, we’ll keep gathering player feedback to refine and improve the game. Your input is crucial to making Stellar Shapers the best it can be!

[h2]Enjoy a special launch discount![/h2]
To celebrate the launch, Stellar Shapers is 10% off during the first week! Don’t miss this chance to embark on an epic journey at a special price!

🚀 [b]Jump into the game now and experience all the exciting Early Access features![/b] 🚀
